# Build Pipeline Reference

## Stages

| Stage | Command | Failure policy |
|---|---|---|
| lint | `make lint` | fail fast |
| test | `make test-ci` | fail fast |
| package | `make dist` | retry once |

## Nested example

````text
Run the smoke suite against a staging cluster:

```bash
make smoke TARGET=staging
```

Exit code 0 means all probes passed; any other code aborts the pipeline.
````

## Notes

Retry logic applies only to the package stage. The lint and test stages never
retry, because a flaky failure there hides a real defect. Cache keys include
the compiler version, so toolchain upgrades rebuild from scratch.
